summary: The candidate is a partial implementation and honest limitation report. Caller IDs are parsed and aligned, and the generic trusted-ID artifact cache works, but only Kimi K3 forwards IDs into that cache. Repeated Qwen video and Whisper audio requests still cross their media-load boundaries twice, general image support is absent, and Responses historical-media reuse lacks compatible multimodal serving evidence or a stored artifact-reference mechanism.

tests.what_was_measured: On base 358c163, two repeated video calls reached Qwen load_mm_data twice and two repeated audio calls reached Whisper load_audio twice.
On candidate e8cac2c, stable caller IDs still did not prevent two Qwen video load boundary crossings or two Whisper audio load boundary crossings.
Candidate focused regression and compatibility suite: 94 passed and 27 subtests passed.
Independent adversarial check patched snapshot_media to fail and confirmed the generic trusted caller-ID hot hit returned the cached artifact without source snapshotting or a second preprocess batch.

gpu_execution.evidence: No compatible multimodal architecture and weights were available. The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot validate the affected multimodal contract and was not used as substitute proof.

remaining_counterexamples: Repeated Chat video_url inputs with the same cache_id still enter Qwen load_mm_data on every request because the processor does not pass cache_ids to prepare_media_artifacts.
Repeated Chat audio_url inputs with the same cache_id still enter Whisper load_audio on every request because the processor does not use the artifact cache.
Caller-ID artifact caching is operational only at the Kimi K3 image processor call site, not across supported image processors generally.

Responses previous_response_id reconstructs historical multimodal messages and has no verified stored artifact-reference path proving historical media skips I/O, decode, preprocessing, and feature hashing.
remaining_limitations: Kimi K3 end-to-end caller-ID reuse was not executed because compatible model weights were unavailable.
Responses multimodal continuation was not executed because the available tiny Llama fixture is not multimodal.
No GPU model execution was performed.
No native source changed in the candidate; native rebuild was not applicable.
